story-context.title: Prompt Assembly Registry Foundation (Closes R6)
story-context.overview:
Stand up the Prompt Assembly Registry (PromptAssemblyProfile*, PromptSection*, PromptSectionVariant*, PromptSectionData) with variant-level versioning, and migrate the five "stored prose" blocks (A ROLE_CONTRACT, B SAFETY, C BRAND_POSTURE with four variants, G FEW_SHOT, I JSON_OUTPUT) from Python string literals into seeded DB variants. The renderer/orchestrator wraps these blocks inside the existing _build_initial_messages path so the assembled prompt remains functionally equivalent to today's output for unchanged inputs. Block G migration moves the on-disk STORY-6.2-AI-CONTEXT-PACK.md content into PromptSectionVariant.PromptSnippet and deletes _load_context_pack(), which is the change that closes R6 (the `context-pack-load-failed` failure on Azure where the markdown file lives outside the deployed backend/ package).
No frontend change. AC-19 introduces a pre-merge prompt-equivalence diff gate that requires Tony's explicit sign-off ("no behavioural degradation") before the Draft PR moves to Ready. Iteration runs locally (uvicorn + LocalDB) per the §5a Local Validation Flow in story-6.5b.md.

critical-objectives.item: Implement registry schema per prompt-assembly-registry-architecture.md §3 and §8.1 (variant-level versioning).
Build Python resolve_prompt_assembly() + render_prompt_assembly() per architecture §4 + §5; no SP this story (hybrid Python-first per §5.4).
Seed FORM_AI_V1 PromptAssemblyProfile + PromptSection rows for A/B/C/G/I + variants matching current production prose.
Block G variant content = current STORY-6.2-AI-CONTEXT-PACK.md (post-trim semantics preserved). Closes R6.
Wire _build_initial_messages to call the renderer for A/B/C/G/I; leave D (locale), E (clarification), F (capability), H (user) on their existing paths unchanged this story.
Delete _load_context_pack() (or replace with deprecation-raising shim) — no runtime file reads for the context pack.
Extend dbo.GenerationRun with PromptAssemblyProfileVersionID and variant-ID columns (or JSON snapshot) for full replayability.

Produce the AC-19 prompt-equivalence diff: pull latest successful GenerationRun, re-assemble via both old code path and new renderer, emit STORY-6.5b-PROMPT-EQUIVALENCE-DIFF.md with per-block verdicts. Get Tony sign-off before PR Ready.
Verify R6 resolved in Test environment after develop deploy (UAT prompt 1, AC-13).

constraints.item: Do NOT run Alembic commands. Create migration files only; Tony reviews and executes. Migrations start at 073_.

Do NOT change the runtime behaviour of D (locale), E (clarification), F (component capability), or H (user prompt) in this story. They remain on their existing paths in _build_initial_messages.
Do NOT introduce ref.BrandPosture or replace the brandPosture enum (deferred to Story 6.5c). Block C variant selection still keys off the existing enum.
Do NOT change the frontend. The AI Agent panel sees zero diff in API contract.
Do NOT delete the file docs/stories/STORY-6.2-AI-CONTEXT-PACK.md from the repo. Add a documentation-only banner pointing to the migration that seeds Block G; the file stays for reference.

Do NOT mark the PR Ready until Tony signs off the AC-19 prompt-equivalence diff. Block G content delta is expected (it's the same prose, just from DB); all other blocks should be character-identical to the current path for the same inputs.
Use PowerShell-safe commands (no '&&' chaining; use ';' if you must chain).
Honour the Green CI/CD rule: full pytest summary with final pass/fail count before commit. Anti-hallucination protocol applies.
